desc: Implement `countGoodArrays` with modular exponentiation (`pow(m-1, n-k-1, mod)`).
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to `n` to support `C(n-1, k)`.
Compute the result as `C(n-1, k) * m % MOD * pow(m-1, n-k-1) % MOD` and return it.
Handle edge cases: `n == 1`, `m == 1`, `k == 0`, and `k == n-1` correctly.
Test with given examples and random brute-force checks for small n, m.
